login.sign_line: Providers, models and roles for ThomasAgent's documents.
login.heading: Sign in to ragx
login.lead: Use the admin account set in RAG_ADMIN_EMAIL.
error.heading: That did not work
error.recover: Reload the page and try again. If it keeps failing, look up the request ID above in the logs.
providers.heading: Providers
providers.lead: Keys are write-only: once saved, ragx never shows them again. Built-in providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Cohere, Voyage, Jina) need only a key.
providers.empty_body: Add the first provider with the form below, then sync or enter its models.
providers.kind_hint: Only azure needs its models entered by hand. The rest sync: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama and openai_compatible ask the provider; Cohere, Voyage and Jina come from ragx's built-in catalog, with no network call.
providers.name: Name
providers.base_url_hint: Required for openai_compatible and azure. For ollama, enter an address the ragx container can reach, for example http://host.docker.internal:11434, because localhost inside the container is not your machine.
providers.api_key_hint: Required, except for ollama and openai_compatible (a local server may need no key).
providers.api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the current key
providers.delete_in_use: Not possible while one of its models is assigned to a role or used by a KB.
models.heading: Models
models.lead: Synced from a provider or entered by hand. Test calls the model once. Embedding size and context window are found out by the system.
models.empty_body: Press Sync models on the Providers page, or enter one by hand below.
models.no_providers: A model belongs to a provider. Add a provider first.
models.name: Model name
models.no_capabilities: No capabilities yet. Edit the model to mark them before testing or assigning a role.
models.delete_in_use: Not possible while it is assigned to a role or used by a KB.
roles.heading: Roles
roles.lead: Each role uses one model. A new KB copies the current embedding model when it is created.
roles.no_capable: No model has the capability for this role yet.
providers.add_lead: Pick a kind, enter the key, then press Sync models on the provider row: ragx fetches the models with their capabilities and context size. Base URL only appears for kinds that need it.
providers.base_url_override_hint: Leave empty to use the provider's default address. Fill it only to go through a proxy.
providers.key_needed: No key yet: Sync may work, but Test and model calls need one. Open Edit to add it.
models.no_match_body: Change or clear the provider, capability or search filter to see more models.
models.dims_pending: size is measured when the role is assigned
models.add_lead: Only for a model that Sync does not list. Pick its capabilities; the embedding size is measured automatically when you assign the Embedding role or press Test.
models.add_hint: No need to enter dimensions or a context window.
roles.embedding_hint: On save, ragx calls the model once to measure its vector size if it is unknown. A model that does not answer is not assigned.
field_error.apikey.required: This provider needs an API key. Enter one (or add it with Edit) and try again.
field_error.baseurl.required: This provider needs a Base URL (the server address).
field_error.baseurl.invalid: The Base URL is not valid: it must start with http:// or https://.
field_error.name.invalid: The name is not valid: enter 1 to 200 characters.
field_error.kind.invalid: The provider kind is not valid.
field_error.capabilities.required: The model has no capabilities yet. Edit the model to mark them before testing.
providers.base_url_changes_key: Changing the address removes this provider saved key; enter a new key in the same edit to keep calling models.
